description: Add nullable quote_items.catalog_description through an additive tenant-safe migration.
Expose catalog_description on persisted quote-item, draft-item, and quote view-model contracts.
Return catalog description from picker search and fallback item retrieval.
Populate immediate draft state with the selected catalog description without replacing editable line description.
Capture the authoritative tenant-scoped catalog description when creating a catalog-backed quote item.
Normalize missing or empty catalog descriptions to null for catalog, custom, and discount lines.
Recapture catalog snapshots only when a line's catalog selection changes, not during unrelated edits.
Preserve stored catalog-description snapshots through duplication and quote revision.
Preserve stored catalog-description snapshots through save-as-template and create-from-template.
Map catalog_description through quote preview and PDF view models and sample scenarios.
Expose Item Name, Catalog Description, and Line Description as distinct quote designer fields.
Add backward-compatible optional stacked lines with per-line styling to table-column AST contracts and validation.
Round-trip and edit stacked table cells in the designer without changing legacy single-value columns.
Render stacked table cells consistently in designer canvas, preview, server HTML, and PDF paths.
Provide an Item name + catalog description table preset with sensible typography and missing-value collapse.
Apply the stacked presentation to standard quote tables across ordinary, recurring, one-time, grouped, and location-grouped layouts.
Leave existing quote rows and customer-owned custom layouts unchanged while updating managed standard templates additively.
Preserve all quote pricing, discount, tax, conversion, and ordering behavior.
